scope: Camping and road-trip gear only; no connection to Paw Shop
duplicates_avoided: Pet Evac Pak Collapsible Cat Litter Box
Kurgo Tru-Fit / Sleepypod Clickit / Ruffwear Load Up harnesses

products.name: Ruffwear Kibble Kaddie Dog Food Carrier
products.why_camp_specific: A 10 L (42-cup) roll-top bag with a waterproof, food-grade odor-sealing liner and a fold-out pour spout, made to carry kibble in a tent, van, or pack without a hard bucket.
products.staging_note: Basalt-gray (or current colorway) nylon roll-top sack, about the size of a small dry bag, with a top spout; stage on a picnic table or tailgate beside an open bag of kibble, woods or camp kitchen in the background.

products.name: Highwave AutoDogMug Dog Water Bottle with Built-in Bowl, 20 oz
products.why_camp_specific: A one-handed 20 oz hiking bottle with a built-in bowl: squeeze to fill, release to return unused water, and it fits a standard car or bike cup holder on the road.
products.staging_note: Tall BPA-free polypropylene bottle (about 4 x 2.75 x 8.5 in) with an attached bowl at the base and a removable strap; blue is the listing default, with pink, purple, red, and smoke also offered. Stage in a cup holder or on a trail rock with a dog drinking from the bowl.

products.name: Dexas Popware for Pets Collapsible Kennel Bowl
products.why_camp_specific: A 2.5-cup collapsible bowl that clips to a kennel door and pivots up to lock flat, so food or water is ready in a crate, hotel room, or car without a loose dish.
products.staging_note: Rectangular plastic kennel cup, about 8.4 x 7.9 in, collapsing to roughly 1.5 in high; often shown in a bright solid color. Stage clipped to a travel crate door or set on a tailgate, either expanded with water or locked flat.

products.name: OneTigris Travel Dog Bed, Waterproof Anti-Slip (Gray)
products.why_camp_specific: A portable, washable, explicitly waterproof and anti-slip dog camping mat (about 3.6 x 2.2 ft) that packs for a tent floor, picnic table, or van bunk.
products.staging_note: Rectangular gray cushioned travel mat with an anti-slip backing, large enough for a medium-to-large dog; stage unrolled at a tent doorway or in the back of an SUV with a slight damp-ground contrast to show the waterproof shell.

products.name: Kritter Planet Waterproof Foldable Dog Bed Pad, Portable Travel Pet Mat
products.why_camp_specific: A foldable, explicitly waterproof travel pad with a roll-up design and handles, listed for camping, car seats, and indoor or outdoor use.
products.staging_note: Cushioned rectangular pad with carry handles that rolls or folds into a compact bundle; stage rolled beside a packed tent or unrolled on a picnic bench or campsite table, for a large or medium dog.

products.name: KZ Dotnz Soft Warm Dog Sleeping Bag, Large Portable Waterproof Camping Pet Bed
products.why_camp_specific: A packable dog sleeping bag sold as a large, portable, explicitly waterproof camping and hiking pet bed — a bag, not a household cushion.
products.staging_note: Soft, packable dog sleeping bag (large size) in a muted outdoor color; stage unzipped on a sleeping pad inside a tent vestibule, or packed in its stuff sack next to a hiking pack.

products.name: Coastal Pet Titan Aerial Dog Run Cable Tie Out Zipline, 50'
products.why_camp_specific: A 50-foot aerial trolley (zipline) kit with a lead line and hardware, so a dog up to 50 pounds can move between two trees at camp without a short ground tie-out.
products.staging_note: Steel cable stretched between two trees with a sliding trolley and lead; often sold in a metallic silver cable with simple hardware. Stage in a wooded campsite, cable high enough to stay off the ground, dog on the run at the edge of camp — never near a water or cliff edge.

products.name: Paw Ballet Foldable Waterproof Portable Cat and Dog Playpen Kennel Tent
products.why_camp_specific: A foldable, explicitly waterproof mesh playpen/kennel tent with a retractable shade cover and carrying case, for giving a cat or small dog a contained outdoor camp or picnic space.
products.staging_note: Pop-up or fold-out mesh playpen tent with a shade roof and carry bag, sized for a cat or small dog; stage set up on a campsite or picnic lawn with the shade extended, stakes visible, carry bag nearby.

products.name: RIS USA 15.5" Travel Cat Litter Box with Zipper Top and Handles
products.why_camp_specific: A lightweight, made-in-USA canvas travel litter pan that folds small for a van or car and zips closed so used litter stays contained on the road.
products.staging_note: White/yellow 15.5 x 15.5 x 4 in canvas pan with a zipper top and handles; folded it is about 12 x 11 x 2 in. Stage open with a thin layer of litter in a van aisle or hotel-style nook, and show the zipped, folded form packed beside a suitcase.
